reviewer: I actually opened all 17 exact original PNGs with Read, used source-pages 01-05 only as enlarged review aids, and actually opened naiwa.png. I compared the visible hair, facial hair, eyewear, headgear, clothing, pose, crop, lighting, frames, notes, backplates and transparent exteriors against the mascot reference's compact rounded yellow head, green-ringed black eyes and small mouth. Repair focuses come from the supplied current rejection reasons; unresolved tiny details are explicitly limited rather than inferred from asset names.

entries.source_features_prompt: Brown leather flight cap with one pair of goggles resting on the forehead; brown hair fringe at the sides, dark eyebrows, and no distinct moustache or beard visible. Khaki/beige flight clothing with two beige collar sides separated by a dark open V extending down the upper chest; no tie or closed central fastening is visible. Do not add separate spectacles unless the exact source pixels support them.
entries.composition_prompt: Keep the nearly frontal head and squared shoulders, forward gaze, neutral closed-mouth expression, static upper-chest bust crop, and warm high-contrast directional lighting with deep shadows from the cap and goggles.
entries.background_prompt: The exterior is transparent, not a photographic backplate. Use a neutral working matte only outside the bust silhouette for the opaque RGB pass; invent no interior backdrop, halo, smoke, frame or note. Restore the exact source alpha afterward.
entries.repair_focus: Current rejection: the raw changed the source-visible open beige collar into a high closed collar with a central fastened seam/button. Preserve the two collar sides and dark open V down the upper chest while fitting them broadly to the mascot; do not close or button that opening.
entries.visible_limitations: At 42x46, the eye/bridge pixels do not reliably establish separate spectacles, and very fine upper-lip hair is not readable; do not invent either.
